description: Comparison of [sys] cfg files shipped with the SDK across all 5 models that support PPA estimation (system_configs/*.cfg, read directly - no disassembly). Pythia-70m is also shipped but has no [sys] cfg since compilation/PPA estimation is unsupported for it per GEN2 User Guide.pdf.
finding: mCluster/pCluster/xTile, and nonzero DDR/OCRAM0, appear ONLY in bevformer.cfg among the 5 shipped models. All other models use nMPs in {1,4,8} and frequency=1GHz; only BEVFormer uses nMPs=288 and frequency=2GHz. Pythia-70m has no [sys] cfg at all (unsupported for compilation/PPA estimation in this SDK version).
